title: Taiwanese American Professionals San Diego
content_html: Taiwanese American Professionals San Diego (TAP-SD) is a chapter of the Taiwanese American Citizens League (TACL), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit run entirely by volunteers. TAP-SD serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater San Diego area through social, cultural, professional, and community service events. The chapter organizes the annual San Diego Taiwan Festival, a large-scale public cultural celebration.
